description: Show one of the signed-in person's Drint projects in 3D with its own design printed on it, in a viewer they can rotate and open in Drint. Take the id from list_my_projects. A project with several products (a set) can name one with product (its number from 0). On the Free plan the product wears Drint's watermark grid, as in the studio.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

product.description: Which product of a set (0 = first). Optional.

name: open_my_project
title: Open my project in 3D
